description: The LLM's calibrated opinion that one evidence group is a real attack.

cache_key.description: SHA-256 of the view, prompt, model and settings.
cache_key.title: Cache Key

calibrator_version.description: Calibrator that produced p_llm; null when p_llm is null.
calibrator_version.title: Calibrator Version

entity.description: Group key, part 2: source-side entity as C3 computes it (real value; this record stays on the app host, the model only ever saw a masked token).
entity.title: Entity

failure.description: Why there is no opinion (status failed only).
failure.title: Failure

incident_id.description: Incident the group belongs to; null for a calibration group.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

method.description: samples = share of 'yes' over n answers; logprob = token probability of 'yes'.
method.title: Method

p_llm.description: Calibrated probability (Platt scaling); null when no calibrator was given or the opinion failed. This is the value C3's stacker reads.
p_llm.title: P Llm

samples_valid.description: Answers that parsed as yes or no.
samples_valid.title: Samples Valid

shown_event_ids.description: The events the model was shown (up to the view cap).
shown_event_ids.title: Shown Event Ids

status.description: ok = p_raw is set; failed = no opinion.
status.title: Status

technique.description: Group key, part 1: dataset attack type, or 'unknown'.
technique.title: Technique

title: GroupOpinion
